title: Metadata save door drops a zod issue's params: 422 INVALID_METADATA issues carry code 'custom', not the registered refusal code
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmSBA2pE8xHD9x1XEXj

Filed as a `finding` by the #36526 card thread of seat `repo:objectstack#2`, from the dev's report on PR #36579 (card comment 7088965055, `out_of_scope_findings`) and the L2 delta record 7089038764 (③). Not triaged; not claimed.

## What

PR #36579 stamps the `controlled_by_parent` master refusal with `params: { code: CONTROLLED_BY_PARENT_MASTER_INVALID, shape }` on its zod issue and registers the code in `ERROR_CODE_LEDGER` under `@objectstack/spec`. The code is visible on the zod issue itself (`ObjectSchema` / `ObjectStackDefinitionSchema` `safeParse`, which is the Studio settings tab's path) and on `defineStack`'s `STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID` raw issues.

It is NOT visible on the metadata save door. `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-metadata-issues.ts` (`zodIssuesToMetadataIssues` / `collectMetadataIssues`, entry built near line 278 at PR head c8366b96) maps each issue to `{ path, message, code: issue.code }`, so the entry's `code` is zod's `'custom'` and `params` is dropped. `protocol-save.ts`, `protocol-package-commits.ts`, `protocol-client-failures.ts` and the read-path diagnostics all go through that one mapper (L2 record 7089038764, S2).

## Why it matters

A client of the save door (anything other than Studio, which parses locally) that is refused with `422 INVALID_METADATA` for this rule cannot read the registered code or the shape and has only the English message. The same holds for any other spec refusal that carries a code on `params.code` (precedent: `PLUGIN_UI_REQUIRED_KEY_MISSING`).

## Where the fix likely lands

`packages/metadata-protocol` (the issue mapper) and the `INVALID_METADATA` issues entry shape, which is a wire change (`MetadataIssueEntry`). Not decided here. Read from code only; not exercised over HTTP.

## Re-check

`grep -n "code: issue.code" packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-metadata-issues.ts` and check whether the entry carries `params` (or a spec code read from `params.code`): no params on the entry = still present.
